title: Change management: framework mapping
frameworks: PCI DSS v4.0.1, PCI Security Standards Council
IT general controls tested under SOX 404 (PCAOB AS 2201)
NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, Security and Privacy Controls

CM-01: Every production change has a ticket, a risk classification and approval from someone other than the author before release.
Sampled changes with ticket, non-author approval and release approval
CM-02: Security requirements and secure development practices are built into the development life cycle and into projects.
SDLC procedure and a sample of security requirements on tickets
CM-03: Changes pass automated checks and, where required, user acceptance testing before release.
Passing CI checks and UAT sign-off for sampled changes
CM-04: Development, test and production environments are separated.
Environment diagram and access lists per environment
CM-05: Access to make changes in production is restricted, and developers cannot approve and deploy their own changes.
Repository protection settings and production access list
CM-06: The security and control impact of significant changes is assessed before approval.
Risk classification and impact notes on sampled changes
CM-07: After significant changes, affected controls are confirmed to still operate and changes are monitored.
Post-change checklist and configuration change alerts
CM-08: Production data is not used in test, and test data and accounts are removed before release.
Test data procedure and pre-release checklist
CM-09: Unapproved software and configuration changes are prevented or detected on platforms.
